question: Your Westpac Business Card payment was 2 days late on 2 Nov ($8,450 balance) immediately following your $12,450 ATO BAS debit. Would an automated Tax Buffer Account prevent this?
why_asking: Why am I asking? On 27 Oct your account paid $12,450 to the ATO, which drew down your cash reserve and resulted in your 2 Nov Westpac credit card payment clearing 2 days late with a $25 late fee.
answer_options: Yes, automatically sweep 15% of all client revenue into a Tax Buffer sub-account
Set an overdraft alert 5 days before BAS due dates
I had invoice payments arriving late from commercial builders
Skip question
impact: Critical CCR Impact: Under Australian Comprehensive Credit Reporting (CCR), late repayments on corporate credit cards backed by a Director Personal Guarantee get recorded on your personal Equifax consumer file, negatively affecting your personal borrowing capacity.

question: You charged $14,750 in trade supplies (Rexel, Middy's, NHP) to your Altitude card across September and October. Are these expenses reimbursed by client claims?
why_asking: Why am I asking? Large trade supply debits cleared to Rexel ($3,420, $3,110), Middy's ($2,890, $2,450), and NHP ($1,940) representing over 40% of your revolving limit.
answer_options: Yes, they are project materials billed back to head contractors on 30-day terms
No, they are ongoing inventory stock holding
I use this card exclusively for Qantas points on trade spend
Skip question
impact: Credit Utilization & Serviceability: High revolving card utilization right before billing cycles triggers elevated risk flags with commercial underwriters. Shifting trade suppliers to 30-day direct wholesale trade credit keeps personal card limits unclogged.

question: We identified a commercial credit inquiry from Dun & Bradstreet / illion on 29 Oct ($45.00). Did you open a new trade credit line?
why_asking: Why am I asking? An assessment fee for a trade credit check appeared on 29 Oct, shortly after your quarterly BAS payment.
answer_options: Yes, I opened a 30-day trade account with an electrical wholesaler
No, it was an inquiry from a head builder vetting my business solvency
Just exploratory; I did not proceed
Skip question
impact: Commercial File Integrity: Commercial credit checks are logged on your illion/Equifax Commercial Bureau file. Keeping commercial credit inquiries clean ensures your business maintains an 'A-Grade' rating for government and commercial tenders.

question: You made ad-hoc drawings of $12,500 to personal accounts alongside personal items (e.g., $234.50 at Woolworths). Would a fixed Director Salary transfer help separate your records?
why_asking: Why am I asking? Irregular drawings were transferred on 20 Aug ($2k), 9 Sep ($2.5k), 23 Sep ($1.8k), 8 Oct ($2k), 22 Oct ($2.2k), and 5 Nov ($2k), plus a weekend grocery charge on 29 Aug.
answer_options: Yes, automate a fixed fortnightly Director Salary of $3,500
Keep flexible transfers based on cash flow availability
Flag commingled personal charges automatically for my bookkeeper
Skip question
impact: Lending Assessment (APRA Serviceability): When a business owner applies for personal refinancing, underwriters examine commingling. Clean separation between commercial cash flow and personal director remuneration dramatically speeds up mortgage and credit line approvals.

question: You hold a flawless $1,150/month repayment record on your Toyota commercial vehicle loan. Would you like to review asset finance refinancing options?
why_asking: Why am I asking? On-time debits of $1,150.00 cleared reliably on 25 Aug, 25 Sep, and 25 Oct.
answer_options: Yes, check if Westpac Commercial Asset Finance offers lower rates
Keep the existing vehicle facility until payout
Show how this commercial liability impacts my personal borrowing capacity

impact: Positive Profile: Flawless commercial asset finance repayments demonstrate commercial maturity, qualifying your business for unsecured Westpac Business Overdraft discounts.
